document_summary: Boston Department of Neighborhood Development's February 2017 Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy, which limits use of criminal history and credit in tenant selection for DND-funded and inclusionary housing in Boston, MA.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (criminal history)
rules.requirement: Covered housing providers may not use a blanket policy denying housing to anyone with arrests or convictions and must assess applicants case by case. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, convictions subject to judicial relief (expungement, sealing), juvenile records, or convictions more than 5 years old.
rules.key_value: No blanket bans; exclude non-conviction arrests, sealed/expunged convictions, juvenile records, and convictions over 5 years old
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or with income restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy; also applied to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity Affirmative Marketing Program. Not a general private-market rule.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing sought and/or unreasonable risk of substantial harm to the safety of others, or to current criminal behavior. Conflicting federal or state criminal history requirements preempt the policy.
rules.interaction: Federal or state law imposing a conflicting criminal history requirement preempts this policy.
rules.citation: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (Feb. 2017)
rules.quoted_span: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions.
rules.extraction_notes: Effective date null: the page footer shows only 'February 2017' as the policy date, with no stated effective or operative date. Official policy/guidance document, not an ordinance; applies via funding or land conditions.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (credit)
rules.requirement: Covered agents agree not to use an applicant's credit score to approve or deny housing applications. Credit history may be considered only in lieu of rental history, when rental history is unavailable, and lack of credit history alone is not sufficient to reject an applicant.
rules.key_value: Ban on using credit score to approve or deny applications
rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy; also applied to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity Affirmative Marketing Program.
rules.citation: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (Feb. 2017)
rules.quoted_span: The agent agrees not to use the applicant credit score to approve or deny housing applications.
rules.extraction_notes: Effective date null: only 'February 2017' appears in the page footer, with no stated effective date. Limited to DND-funded and inclusionary units, not all Boston rentals.
